name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on the European Union's budget for 2027. It rejects the Council's cuts and asks to restore and add money to many programmes: research, transport, health, education, farming, environment, migration, defence, aid abroad and agencies fighting fraud and crime. It also asks for extra money for the Parliament's own pension payments and for several European Union bodies. This is the Parliament's negotiating position, not a final budget.

- Parliament adds money to many European Union programmes and reverses the Council's cuts.
- It affects students, farmers, researchers, health services, regions, agencies and European Union staff.
- Talks with the Council follow; both must agree before the budget is final.
